title: SDD apply — cli
content:
All **15 CLI acceptance scenarios** are implemented and green (`go test ./...`). The starter already had the full command surface; this pass closed the remaining gaps and committed them as `964441d`.

### Surface
`list` · `check` (`--ci`) · `doctor` · `diff` · `run` · `get`/`set`/`delete` · `import`/`export` (`--reveal`) · `agent grant`/`revoke`

Secrets stay redacted by default. Agent writes need `--as-agent` + an active grant. Mutations append to `.envy/audit.jsonl` without plaintext secrets.

### This pass
- `Project.SetClock` + grant **TTL expiry** denial test (scenario 13)
- Grant UI label aligned to **`read_values`** (denied by default)
- Hardened doctor score assertions

### Code review

## Standards
- Hard: a few CLI funcs >50 lines; audit persist errors still swallowed
- Judgement: flag-parser duplication; `cli_ops.go` hotspot

## Spec
- All 15 scenarios covered with working paths + tests (including TTL)
- Partials: gitignore is warn without `.git`; bare `check` uses active env

**Summary:** Standards ~4 · Spec ~2 non-blocking. Nothing blocking delivery.
